title: AIOS Governance Policy Record
description: Defines the strictly bounded rules under which Contracts and Actions are permitted to execute.

policy_id.description: Stable, globally unique policy identifier (e.g., finance-require-auth-v1).

version.description: Semantic version of the policy record.

description.description: Human‑readable explanation of the policy’s purpose and scope.

targets.description: The exact scope to which this policy applies. At least one array must be populated.

node_ids.description: List of NodeContract IDs this policy applies to.

action_ids.description: List of action IDs (MCP endpoints or system actions) this policy applies to.

cel_expression.description: Common Expression Language (CEL) string evaluated against the OS SessionContext. Must return a boolean.

required_context_keys.description: Variables the Policy Engine must inject into the CEL evaluator (e.g., 'session.is_authenticated').

effect.description: The deterministic outcome if the CEL expression evaluates to true.

priority.description: Resolution weight. If multiple policies match, the highest priority dictates the final effect.

audit_level.description: Controls what data is written to the immutable ExecutionViolationLog. 'strict_redaction' ensures PII is excluded.

failure_mode.description: System behavior if the CEL expression crashes or required context keys are missing. fail_open is highly restricted and triggers Tier 3 review.

ui_component.description: Canonical UI component to render when the policy denies or escalates.

tts_message.description: Optional text‑to‑speech message to accompany the fallback UI.

fallback_directive.description: Optional safe fallback state if the effect is 'deny' or escalation occurs.
